text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clamps section 4 (38.1 mm bore, 50 mm outside, 64 long),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a pad on top and two cheeks 3 mm thick, 28 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Split along the bottom, 2 mm wide; two lugs with a 4.2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole for the M4 clamp screw and nyloc nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.2 mm holes down through the pad, 10.5 mm either side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre and 36 mm apart along the rod: the housings

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stop 2 mm under the top; 1.2 mm holes on up for the wires.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rod's centre line; mark the centre detent on one cheek.
